answer: Before the stamp comes £26 in fees and a 13-day delay before the stamp dries, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. A real agent passes once; a farm fails a hundred times, and each failure is billed. Nobody walks in twice on the same papers; Enamelbound acid keeper jewel seal sees to it, since a seal acid keepers renew after gold shop hearings. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. Every pearl is counted once. The tally keeps wander. One forge, one entry.
